items.paraphrase: Habitable rooms need 2.70 m net height; corridors, bathrooms and storerooms 2.40 m; 2.55 m allowed above 1,000 m altitude.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via bosettiegatti.eu (full text of the decree); 2.40 m allowed for corridors, baths, stores, 2.55 m in mountain communes

items.paraphrase: Openable window area must be at least one eighth of floor area, with average daylight factor of about 2 percent.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via bosettiegatti.eu; ratio refers to openable window area, with a mean daylight factor of at least 2 percent

items.paraphrase: Entrance door of a building or unit needs 0.80 m clear width; other doors 0.75 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via unipr.it PDF of the full decree text; 0.80 m for building and dwelling entrance doors, 0.75 m for other doors

items.paraphrase: Corridors are at least 1.00 m wide with passing and turning widenings at the ends and about every 10 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via unipr.it PDF of the full decree text

items.paraphrase: Accessible ramp slope is at most 8 percent, steeper only when adapting existing buildings.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via unipr.it PDF of the full decree text; higher slopes allowed only when adapting existing buildings

items.paraphrase: Shared or public stair flights are at least 1.20 m wide.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via unipr.it PDF of the full decree text; common/public stairs 1.20 m wide and 0.30 m tread, other stairs 0.80 m and 0.25 m

items.paraphrase: Shared or public stairs have treads of at least 0.30 m, with twice the riser plus tread between 0.62 and 0.64 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via unipr.it PDF of the full decree text; common/public stairs 1.20 m wide and 0.30 m tread, other stairs 0.80 m and 0.25 m

items.paraphrase: Stairs inside a private dwelling are at least 0.80 m wide.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via unipr.it PDF of the full decree text; common/public stairs 1.20 m wide and 0.30 m tread, other stairs 0.80 m and 0.25 m

items.paraphrase: Private-dwelling stairs have a minimum going of 0.25 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via unipr.it PDF of the full decree text; common/public stairs 1.20 m wide and 0.30 m tread, other stairs 0.80 m and 0.25 m

items.paraphrase: Wheelchair full-turn space is a circle of about 1.50 m diameter.

items.clause: Table 3.1.II, category A residential areas: qk = 2.00 kN/m2
items.paraphrase: Residential floor areas in category A carry a characteristic imposed load of 2.00 kN/m2; common stairs and balconies carry 4.00.

items.clause: Table 3.1.II, category B2 offices open to the public: qk = 3.00 kN/m2; B1 closed offices 2.00
items.paraphrase: Offices open to the public (B2) use 3.00 kN/m2 and offices closed to the public (B1) use 2.00 kN/m2 as imposed floor load.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: gazzettaufficiale.it/eli/gu/2018/02/20/42/so/8/sg/pdf; value 3.0 is the B2 (public) case; B1 would be 2.0
